messages.text: BL-2107 🎵 in progress — Stamp-off for hotfix 597801eadd: BL-1700 scenario 03's leak check scanned ps host-wide for .probe.tmux.sock and stand-in.sh, so a live steward probe on the host turned it red (a prepared-alias probe started 18:46Z and a probe tmux left since 17:58Z on 2026-10-09); the check now counts only probe processes that appeared during the scenario
